records.name: percentage transform accumulate
records.nativeDifference: Chromium 155 serializes zero translation for mismatched percentage-based accumulation. The target width remains 150px before and after resize: 12% = 18px, -10% = -15px, 40% = 60px. CSS Transforms 2 requires matrix conversion and arithmetic accumulation; the independent pixel reference retains the translations.
